title: Log-concavity and normalized Gibbs measures
summary: The repository has local definitions and reusable leaves for positive log-concavity, Gibbs densities, finite nonzero normalization, and selected convex-potential consequences.
blockers: The full coercivity-to-normalizability hierarchy used across the textbook is incomplete.
Prekopa-Leindler and Brunn-Minkowski are not locally formalized.

title: Langevin generator and finite-dimensional weighted-divergence display
summary: Coordinate, basis, gradient, Laplacian, and weighted-divergence identities compile locally. They establish the formal differential expression, not the operator domain or invariant law.
blockers: Closed generator and semigroup domain semantics.

title: Whole-space weighted integration by parts and Gibbs invariance
summary: Finite-box cancellation, smooth cutoffs, first-derivative bounds, and generic dominated-convergence handoffs exist, but the concrete Gibbs-tail passage and operator-domain branch are not closed.
blockers: Concrete Gibbs-weighted generator and score integrability.
Invariant Gibbs law with a valid generator/semigroup domain.

title: Poincare, log-Sobolev, transport, and dissipation
summary: Scalar KL/Fisher/Dirichlet algebra and selected log-Sobolev handoffs compile, while the analytic inequality packages and preservation hierarchy remain incomplete.
blockers: General Poincare and log-Sobolev theorem interfaces.
Tensorization, perturbation, transport, concentration, and isoperimetry packages.

title: Probability kernels and conditional expectation representatives
summary: ASTIS has exact almost-everywhere bridges between Mathlib conditional distributions, conditional-expectation kernels, mapped kernels, and selected Bochner-integral fields.
blockers: A general stochastic-process filtration and adaptedness layer.
Source-specific representative choices still have to be justified at each consumer.

title: Girsanov, Doob transforms, and path-space change of measure
summary: Finite-dimensional Gaussian cylinder likelihood and measure identities compile and provide a base case. The continuous Brownian path-space theorem has not been packaged.
blockers: Filtered probability spaces, adapted drift, stochastic exponential, and Novikov-style conditions.
Brownian path-space Radon-Nikodym identity, Doob transform, and Follmer drift.

title: Continuous Langevin process to discrete sampling algorithms
summary: SDE and sampler contract records exist, but full LMC interpolation, convergence, stability, and error theorems are not local compiled theorem packages.
blockers: Euler/LMC transition kernel and interpolation construction.
Strong or weak approximation error and convergence assembly.

title: Accelerated, high-accuracy, proximal, structured, and generative-model routes
summary: Chapters 5-12 are mapped as downstream consumers of shared measure, functional-inequality, stochastic-process, and discretization roots.
blockers: Rate proofs with constants matching the textbook.
Lower-bound oracle models and diffusion-model score-error interfaces.

title: External Lean and textbook dependencies
summary: Mathlib, cited textbooks, papers, and audited Lean repositories are proof sources and port references. They are never represented as ASTIS-local certificates until an owned declaration compiles.
blockers: Each imported idea needs an exact source theorem, license check, API comparison, and local ownership decision.
